content.title: The Score: GM, Tesla, Palantir, American Airlines and More Stocks That Defined the Week
content.summary: Trade-sensitive stocks rose Wednesday as the Supreme Court heard oral arguments on the case challenging the broad array of global tariffs President Trump has imposed. The Trump administration’s top lawyer faced sharp questioning, including from some members of the court’s conservative wing.
